purpose: RESEARCH ONLY, EXPLORATORY: why is the best unrostered IDP valued above the lowest rostered IDP starter in dynasty_main?  No production code, value or config changed.

inputs.temporalLedger: data/temporal_ledger.sqlite is NOT present in this checkout; served history between 2026-08-25 and today is unavailable locally

H1_dataDefect.test: every board player row the shadow replay counts as unrostered (name not in sleeper.teams[].players) checked by Sleeper id against the SAME snapshot's playerIds and against LIVE Sleeper rosters (players incl. taxi/reserve), plus Sleeper directory status

H2_lineupDefinition.objective: canonical rankDerivedValue — data_contract.contract_roster_pools feeds RosterPlayer.ros_value = rankDerivedValue to lineup.assign_lineup (stamp_optimal_lineups); NOT projections and NOT realized points

H3_scoringMismatch.test: Spearman rank correlation between canonical value and weeks-1..N (ppg: per game played, >= minGames; perTeamWeek: total / N weeks, every player with a weekly line) league-scored points per game (players with >= minGames), today's board (hindsight-contaminated: it already knows the season) and the SERVED 2026-08-25 pre-season board

H5_boardMovement.test: median today/then value ratio, both values from TODAY's code (sensitivity replay: inputs move, methodology fixed), and today's replay over the SERVED pre-season value (mixes input moves AND pipeline changes)

readout.H2: lineups are solved on canonical value, so the anomaly is in value space; the lowest-valued IDP starters are productive veterans (see lowestValuedCanonicalStarter)
